name: Melissa's Super 80s Movies Challenge: Volume 2
description: Melissa returns in 10 epic 80s movie scenes: prom night in pink, a convertible joyride, a sunset beach gallop, a sky-ace dogfight, a lightning-fast 88 mph time dash, a neon roller rink, ghost sweeping, a barn dance rebellion, a light-cycle grid race and a moonshot finale. Painted art, bosses and an original synthwave score.
